\u2605_WHY_THIS_HAS_ITS_OWN_FILE: This evidence was produced as a GATE INSIDE a bias test (m6_skill_vs_bias_exact.py) and would have been invisible to anyone looking for reproducibility evidence, which is where it actually matters most. Invariant 7 asserts a reproducibility deliverable that the project has otherwise ARGUED rather than DEMONSTRATED across environments — and 49/49 run records once asserted bit-exactness on a premise that was false. This is the demonstration, harvested into the place a reader would look.
what_was_reproduced: Seed 4's cell-1 GROSS period series over the full pinned money grid (35,064 stride-15 periods, 40 symbols, 1,402,520 decisions), rebuilt from the checkpoint through the production path: tokenization -> mu-hat -> position filter -> equal-weight pooling.

reproduction.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (different physical machine, vast 47715433)
reproduction.separation: weeks later, different host, different CUDA minor, different torch minor

\u2605_WHAT_IT_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_ESTABLI: ESTABLISHES: the scored INFERENCE path reproduces across torch versions and physical hardware to 3.5e-04 in IR with a bit-identical period-active set — strong evidence for the prediction-replay half of invariant 7, obtained for free. DOES NOT ESTABLISH: (1) BIT-EXACTNESS — it is agreement to a tolerance, not equality, and the residual 2.587e-04 is exactly the float32 reduction-order effect invariant 7 already concedes deterministic attention does not remove; (2) anything about TRAINING reproducibility, which is where the same-seed basin-hopping finding lives and which this does not touch; (3) generality beyond cell 1 seed 4 — one arm, one seed.
